question: What power is attributed to the ten-syllabled great vidyā for all beings?
premises: A ten-syllabled great vidyā is identified
It is related to all beings
It is remembered as giving accomplishment
inference: The ten-syllabled great vidyā is remembered as granting accomplishment to all.
uncertainties: The form smṛntrā is retained as given.
plain_english: The ten-syllabled great vidyā is remembered as giving accomplishment to all.
